Amina (People Ops): Heads-up: EU finalization window is next week (May 12-16). Forms lock at 17:00 CET on Fri May 16. We still need swaps for 8 reviewer bundles and two manager handbacks flagged as missing sign-off. Please read below for the quick ops plan.

Luca Bianchi: Is the lock absolute or is there an exception process?

Amina (People Ops): Lock is automatic for forms; exceptions require the Exception Request flow and manager approval beforehand. We can grant a 72-hour extension for verified medical/LOA reasons. Use reason code `EU-EXT-72`.

Eve Chen: I'm in EU and can take 2 bundles evenings CET. How do I claim?

Amina (People Ops): Add your name to the EU Swap sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EU-review-swaps. Column headers: Name | Bundles | Timezone | Can QA sample? (Y/N) | Notes.

Rahul Iyer: Quick Q on manager handback: if reviewer submits late under exception, does manager still have to sign off before forms close?

Amina (People Ops): Yes — manager sign-off is required for finalization. If manager is out, escalate to their leadership or use the delegated sign-off field on the form. We'll mark the manager field `DELEGATED` and record approver name.

Ana Gomez: Two managers on my team are traveling next week. Can People Ops run a temporary delegation?

Amina (People Ops): We can, but we need an email confirmation from the manager's director. Use this template: 

```
Subject: Delegated review approval for <Manager Name> - <Dates>
Body: Hi <Director>,
This email confirms delegation of review finalization for <Manager Name> between <start> and <end>. Delegate: <Delegate Name>.
Thanks,
People Ops
```

People Ops Bot: Reminder: Training micro-session "Calibrating with Rubric v3.2" tomorrow 08:30 CET. Recording will be posted.

Luca Bianchi: Is rubric v3.2 the one with the updated collaboration criteria?

Amina (People Ops): Yep — small changes to Collaboration and Customer Impact anchors. We recommend watching the 10-min micro-session if you're reviewing.

Eve Chen: Can we anonymize names for the calibration sample? Helps reduce bias.

Amina (People Ops): Good call. For calibration we'll use anonymized slices. People Ops will pull a 5% stratified sample across levels and teams. If you want to volunteer as a calibration anchor, add `ANCHOR` next to your name in the sheet.

Rahul Iyer: Who are calibration anchors and what's expected?

Amina (People Ops): Anchors help lead the score discussion for a cluster (10-12 reviews). Expect a 30m prep read + 45m sync during calibration. Compensation: 2 hours of protected time counted toward headcount review duties.

Ana Gomez: Two manager sign-offs are still missing for ENG-Platform (IDs: MGR-334, MGR-338). We're blocked on finalization.

Amina (People Ops): Noted. I'll ping their directors and run delegated approvals if we don't hear back within 6 hours. 

Talent Systems Bot: Auto-note: Forms will begin auto-lock countdown in 24 hours. Current open items: 8 reviewer bundles unassigned, 2 manager sign-offs pending.

Amina (People Ops): Operational checklist (paste into your onboarding Slack message if you pick up bundles):

- Confirm you have access to review form (People Ops shares)
- Complete review by your claimed deadline
- Add `ANON-QA` if you want your review in anonymized calibration pool
- Notify manager for handback within 24h of submission
- If manager absent, submit delegation email template

Amina (People Ops): CSV bulk for systems team if you prefer to upload claims programmatically: 

```
reviewer_name,reviewer_email,bundles_claimed,timezone,flags
Eve Chen,eve@redwood.ai,2,CET,ANCHOR
Luca Bianchi,luca@redwood.ai,1,CET,
```

Luca Bianchi: I'll take 1 bundle and mark ANCHOR? I can anchor one cluster.

Eve Chen: Added 2 bundles to sheet. Marked yes for QA sample.

People Ops Bot: Event created: "EU calibration sync - rubric v3.2" Tue 09:00 CET. RSVP auto-populated from sheet anchors.

Rahul Iyer: If someone misses manager sign-off before lock, what's escalation?

Amina (People Ops): Step 1: People Ops sends escalation to manager + director. Step 2: If no response within 6 hours, People Ops marks finalization as `PENDING-DELEGATION` and will assign a delegated approver (director or People Ops designee). Step 3: Last resort: record as `Escalation-Exec` and notify ELT. We expect this only in <1% of cases.

Ana Gomez: Can People Ops share the finalization summary after lock? Need it for comp calibration meeting.

Amina (People Ops): Yes — we'll publish a CSV with final scores, flags (exceptions, delegated approvals), and anonymized calibration deltas within 48 hours after lock.

People Ops Bot: :alarm_clock: Final reminder: forms lock 17:00 CET Fri May 16. Use exception flow early to avoid emergency escalations.

Amina (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If you can pick up an overflow bundle, please update the sheet in the next 12 hours. I'll post a final roster and the calibration sample list tomorrow morning.
